messages.content: I’ll build a day-ahead book that balances energy sales with reserve income, then monitor each watch and adjust unfrozen battery dispatch as conditions change. Ancillary-service awards will be fixed after watch 0.

Overnight RegDn deployment was much higher than its planning mean, pushing the battery close to full. I’m revising dispatch to create charging room, protect the remaining fixed reserve awards, and preserve discharge capacity for the evening.

ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin for 19:27–20:26. Our fixed book has no Non-Spin awards in those hours. The 20:00 discharge is frozen; I’ll schedule a small late recharge to cover a possible end-of-day shortfall if RegDn deployment stays near zero.
